segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, it’s Mark. Appreciate you making the time. I have the workspace open from our last call, so I wanted to confirm the 42 seats and the May 6 go-live target.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that’s right. Forty-two seats to start. We may add another 8 in Q3, but I don’t want those on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. The order form will show 42 seats at $68 per seat per month, annual term, billed upfront. That comes to $34,272 before tax for May 1 through April 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And can the invoice be dated May 1? Our finance team is closing April early, so if it lands in April it creates a little mess.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, invoice date May 1. Payment terms are net 30, so due May 31. I’ll put that directly in the billing notes and on the order form so it matches.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On the services side, you had mentioned the two admin trainings. Are those included or separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. Two 60-minute admin sessions and one end-user kickoff for up to 75 attendees. If you need recorded enablement after that, that’s the $900 add-on, but you don’t need to decide today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s skip the add-on for now. Legal already reviewed your standard terms, and the only thing they asked for was the 30-day notice language for non-renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, standard renewal with 30 days’ notice is in there. No auto-price increase in year two unless seats change. If you add those 8 seats later, they’ll co-term to April 30 and be prorated.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send the order form to me and cc our AP alias. If it’s clean, I can sign by Friday, April 19.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have it this afternoon with 42 seats, May 1 invoice date, net 30, and the included trainings listed. After signature, we’ll schedule kickoff for the week of April 22.
